assessment: This article uses a genetically encoded calcium indicator to assess neural activity across a population of axons connecting the fly’s brain to its ventral nerve cord while the tethered fly behaves on a floating ball. The preparation and large-scale analysis represent a significant step forward in determining how the brain compresses sensory and state information to convey commands to the ventral nervous system for behavior execution by motor circuits.
